description: If no retained application represents an input tuple, the specified function map returns the default point.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.functionMap_of_unrepresented.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.SubtermClosed S) {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n)
  (xs : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S E hE)
  (h : IsEmpty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.ApplicationWitness S E hE ⋯ f xs)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.functionMap S E hE ⋯ f xs = none
